LanguageData.TXWC_GasPerUnitDesc: How many cells of tox gas one unit from the tank makes, wherever it is spent: the vent, the burst when the pilot goes down or dies, and the gas jet, whether from the tank or from the nozzles' own jets. The helmet's absorb banks a unit for every unit's worth of gas it draws in. A tox pack fills 45 cells. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_TankCapacityDesc: How many units the warcasket's tank holds. Each unit is reloaded with 2 chemfuel. A tank holding more than a lowered capacity loses the excess. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_VentRateDesc: How fast the vent empties the tank. A faster vent spreads the same gas wider and it clears sooner. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_JetCostDesc: How many units each gas jet draws from the tank. Without a tank, one of the nozzles' own jets makes the same gas and reloads with the same chemfuel. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_JetReserveDesc: How many jets the shoulder nozzles hold on their own, for a pilot wearing them without the tank. They reload with chemfuel, and are neither spent nor reloaded while a tank is worn. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_JetConeWidthDesc: The full width of the cone the gas jet lands in. A wider cone spreads the same gas thinner. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_JetRangeDesc: How far the gas jet reaches. A longer jet spreads the same gas thinner. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_AbsorbRadiusDesc: How far around the pilot the helmet's absorb draws gas in. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_AbsorbDurationDesc: How long each absorb keeps drawing gas in. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_AbsorbCooldownDesc: How long the helmet's absorb must recharge before it can be used again. Default: {0}.
